title: Mens Non-absorbent Rubber-soled Casual Slippers
body_html:
Product information:
Product Overview:
Designed for both home and hotel environments, these men's casual slippers feature a lightweight, non-slip rubber outsole that offers excellent durability and grip for indoor and outdoor use. The PVC upper is water-resistant and easy to clean, making them a practical and comfortable choice for young adults.

Specifications:
Style: Casual
Upper Material: PVC
Outsole Material: Rubber
Applicable Age: Youth (18-40 years)
Color Options: Khaki with white stripes, Khaki with yellow stripes, Black with black stripes, Khaki with brown stripes, Black with white stripes, Black with yellow stripes
Size Information: 40, 41, 42, 43, 44
